reviews.title: No one answers email or calls.
reviews.text: This Airline is the absolute worst my family has ever dealt with. We habe sent several emails, called and we could never get through to anyone since March 2020. My Aunt has tried to return home and the airline has not given her,, her new airline ticket to return home. She is scheduled to fly home on December 1st, 2020. She received a call from someone at laser, telling her they would email her the new tickets. They never responded nor did they ever send her any ticket. This airline sucks. I can only hope they go out of business. I am half Venezuelan, but, with their current Government, I will never again return to this Country.
reviews.author: Alex P

reviews.title: Cuidado con esta aerolínea
reviews.text: I hope the maintenance department works better than their sales. They sold me a ticket and let me check in even though there are travel restrictions for my country of residence to fly to Venezuela and they wouldn't tell me until it was time to board. So I flew from Miami to Panama to board their plane to Caracas and they bounced me off making me waste $1,500 on a day trip to Panama. If you are going to sell a ticket and know the passport country at the very least notify your customers if there are restrictions before they commit. Just very poorly managed airline.
reviews.author: LonelyWolf

reviews.title: Travelling Pleasure
reviews.text: Even though the reason for taking this flight was due to our return home using Laser Airlines it was the best alternative among different airlines due to time of day for arrival in our destination due to insecurity. The airlines offers a suppurb service and airplanes well maintained
reviews.author: Newhawk

reviews.title: On time
reviews.text: Best Venezuela airline, only issue they ask me to pay for BABY CAR SEAT, all other airlines is for free. I was impress the fly attended help me change diapers to my son
reviews.author: Isaac B

reviews.title: This "airline" it's not a LASER but maybe an oil lamp.
reviews.text: Worst experience EVER, even flying with them. Two hours delay, hot airplane, remote ramp, unhappy and unfriendly crew and a seat that didn't recline in coach even when I had paid Business Class made this flight a real nightmare. Not only that, but before the flight, long and chaotic line at the counter with no Priority boarding, airline personel that want to charge extra for even 2 pounds excess baggage, and a horrible airport like Dominican Republic Santo Domingo Airport makes me shiver remembering that flight. Avoid LASER AIRLINES at all cost.
reviews.author: germanolava

reviews.title: Slow check in process
reviews.text: Waited 2 hours in line just to check in our luggage. Thank goodness we came 4 hours before our flight because the immigration process took another hour. Perhaps some changes to processes could be made - all passengers were required to confirm their itinerary and print their boarding passes with 2 ladies which was the bottleneck. After getting our boarding passes, we walked over to 5 open counters with bored-looking staff for baggage check in. More staff should have been allocated to the boarding pass printing counter. The flight itself was fine. Nothing to complain about. Flight attendants were friendly. Probably could have served us more rum to prepare us for the party in Miami 🥳🥳🥳🥳
reviews.author: Mijotravel

reviews.title: Trip to HR Punta Cana
reviews.text: It was on time. Service and airplane are average and poorly maintained. One of few airlines available in Venezuela.
reviews.author: educomb

reviews.title: everything went as scheduled
reviews.text: they use a small airplane(737-400)but with relative confort.This particular trip was on time with good information to the public and the service onboard was good( including scotch and vodka for free)
reviews.author: takimoi

reviews.title: Cancelled flights and always late
reviews.text: This Is the worst airline I have ever been on. They cancel flights frequently with the consequent delays in following flights nd people left behind. No pre assigned seats. Four and a half hour wait to tell us that maybe we’ll leave tomorrow either at 8 am or 3 pm according to where they can place us. Treated like cattle is not my style. Absolutely no respect for the passenger. Don’t use this airline even if it is cheap. Cheap is sometimes more expensive. At least where my sanity is.
reviews.author: dmayoral1

reviews.title: The trip from memorial weekend
reviews.text: I had to said the staff is very good they smile and food service is great, I was surprised that they serve full lunch and not just pretzels, a big thumbs up Now the airplane is another story, let me put it this way it’s something to take you from point A to point B -_-
reviews.author: Luis A

reviews.title: On time, great service
reviews.text: Great service, web check in available. Affordable. No waiting lines at check in. Actually we got earlier at our destination. Good food. I definitely will fly with them again.
reviews.author: Debilindag

reviews.title: Always late?
reviews.text: This is the second time I fly with laser and the second time it’s had over 2 hours delay. No explanation given. Also they made us get out of the waiting g room so they could set up their own checkpoint. 35 minutes of another line and the 3 rd check. Most of personal are nice
reviews.author: dmayoral1

reviews.title: On Time, good flight
reviews.text: It is old plane, with a nice crew, beverages on board, good web check in and a good counter service. Their only problem is that they charge you in cash the airport Tax, $30 arriving and $53 at the departure

reviews.title: Good flight. Only problem is in the check  in Aruba Airport, very slow process,long waiting lines.
reviews.text: NO complaint about the plane, clean in the inside. Flight very quiet and puntual. Only problem was the waiting time to check in in the Aruba Airport counter. Long lines moving very slow.

reviews.title: EXCELLENT
reviews.text: Excellent...... It's good to know that we have another Airline to that fly from Caracas to the US..... and I recomendad
reviews.author: Ileana B

reviews.title: One of the three airlines who still fligh between the US and Venezuela
reviews.text: After having a hard time to find a reservation for one of the few flights to USA (American, Sta Barbara, and Laser Airlines)we were lucky to find two seats on Laser Airlines, which we used for the first time for our frequent trips to the U.S. and Europe, we were surprised to find comfortable seats, better food than average and excellent service by ground and inflight personnel. We took off and arrived on time. Which is quite a lot to say for charter airline. Better attention than we were accustomed to receive from United and Delta on our previous trips when these big airlines were still flying in and out of Venezuela. American is still doing a good job between Caracas and Miami, but you have to be very lucky to find a seat on their only daily flight to Miami. Good job LASER! .
reviews.author: Dagmar K
